summary_en: Sanwa Holdings authorized acquisition of up to 3.71 million shares (1.8% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 10.0 billion yen via market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 6, 2026 through March 31, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
Sanwa Holdings Corporation's Board of Directors resolved on October 30, 2026 to acquire up to 3.71 million shares of its ordinary stock, representing 1.8% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury shares) as of September 30, 2026, for a maximum total acquisition price of 10.0 billion yen. The acquisition will be conducted via market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 6, 2026 through March 31, 2027.

The company cited three objectives for the buyback program: strengthening returns to shareholders, improving capital efficiency, and enabling flexible execution of capital policies. The maximum acquisition price of 10.0 billion yen provides flexibility in timing and pace of purchases within the authorized period. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 11.79 million treasury shares, and the outstanding share count (excluding treasury shares) stood at 207.21 million shares.
